notes: Not affected by Glintblade sorcery buffs

effect: Increases damage towards Those Who Live in Death by 1.2x

name: Communion Grants Anti-Dragon Effect

effect: Increases damage towards Ancient Draconic enemies by 1.2x and Draconic enemies by 1.3x for 45 seconds

name: Blood Loss in Vicinity Increases Attack Power
description_ingame: Nearby blood loss increases attack power
effect: Increases damage by 1.2x for 20 seconds when bleed is activated

name: Damage Boosted after Critical Hit

effect: Decreases enemy damage negation by 15% for 30 seconds

name: Critical Hits Inflict Blood Loss
description_ingame: Armament inflicts blood loss when performing critical hits

name: Traces of a Grace-Given Lord
description_ingame: Newly found Sites of Grace raise attack power

name: Demon's Plating
description_ingame: Enhances attack power depending on runes in possession
effect: Increases damage by 1.2x at 50k runes, 1.3x at 100k, 1.9x at 900k, and 3x at 2mil

name: Favor of Noklateo, the Shrouded City
description_ingame: Rise from near-death, unaided, a single time and become more powerful for a short time
effect:
After being revived:
Increases HP, FP, and stamina by 1.3x for 40 seconds
Regen 5% of your max HP per second for 10 seconds
~3x faster ultimate art charge for 10 seconds

name: Power to Balance the World
description_ingame: Rise from near-death unaided on occasion. Attack power increases after rising from death.
effect: After being revived, increases damage by 1.1x for 45 seconds

name: Favor of the Mountaintop
description_ingame: Halves frostbite damage and frost buildup. Nearby frostbite boosts attack.
effect:
Reduces frostbite damage and incoming frostbite buildup by 0.5x
Increases damage by 1.15x when frostbite procs for 20 seconds

name: Improved Physical Damage Negation
description_ingame: Boosts physical damage negation
effect: Increases physical damage negation by 12% / 18%

name: Improved Non-Physical Damage Negation
description_ingame: Boosts magic, fire, lightning, and holy damage negation
effect: Increases magic, fire, lightning, and holy damage negation by 12% / 18%

name: Creates Holy Ground at Low HP
description_ingame: At low HP, create holy ground, slowly restore HP, and improve damage negation
effect: Creates a holy ground when HP is below 20%. Heals for 10 hp/s and increases all damage negation by 20%. Lasts for 35 seconds.

name: Improved Poise
description_ingame: Raises poise
effect: Reduces incoming poise damage by 0.75x / 0.62x

name: All Resistances Up
description_ingame: Raises resistance to all ailments

description_ingame: Longer invincibility windows during evasive maneuvers

notes: Does not stack with itself, Crucible Feather Talisman, or the Recluse's triple Lightning cocktail

name: Cold Mirage
description_ingame: Conceals oneself when faced with threats to life, neutralizing all attacks
effect: Turns you invisible at low HP, making you immune to all attacks for a short duration (duration currently unknown)

name: Favor of the Rotten Woods
description_ingame: Nullifies scarlet rot and increases max HP. Attacks after receiving damage partially recover HP.
effect: Increases maximum HP by 1.25x and attacks heal the user after taking damage for a short period of time

name: FP Restoration upon Successive Attacks

name: HP Recovery From Successful Guarding
description_ingame: Successful guards restore HP

name: FP Recovery From Successful Guarding
description_ingame: Successful guards restore FP

name: Unifying Fate

notes: Amount of FP recovered is unknown

name: Beast's Hunt
description_ingame: Successive attacks restore stamina and hasten stamina recovery for self and nearby allies
effect: Recovers 15 stamina on successive attacks and increases stamina regen for self and allies by 5/s for 15 seconds

name: Traces of Grace-Given Lord
effect: Newly found Sites of Grace raise attack power by ~2% each, max 10 stacks. This effect is acquired by defeating the Fell Omen during the Morgott Invasion Event.

name: Favor of the Rotted Woods
effect: Nullifies scarlet rot and increases max HP. Attacks after receiving damage partially recover HP. Acquired by interacting with the Red Flower found during the Shifting Earth: Rotted Woods.

name: Unhealed Wound Carved by the Night
effect: Increases damage taken by 20%. This effect is acquired when the targetted player die to the Fell Omen during the Morgott Invasion Event.
